# Parley v0.1.10

This beta adds Smart Orchestration: a visible, bounded workflow for moving one
cross-vendor objective through planning, review, implementation and
verification without replacing any vendor CLI or bypassing its approvals.

## Smart orchestration

- **Supervised mode** pauses before every handoff so the person can inspect and
  edit the exact plan, critique, implementation instruction and verification
  evidence.
- **Auto mode** advances only after an explicit target returns the exact
  correlated Parley answer for the current stage.
- Every automatic delivery and state transition is attributed as **AUTO** in
  collaboration history, Status Center details, exports and accessibility
  descriptions.
- The workspace lead, reviewer and verifier are explicit agent panes. Auto
  never broadcasts, guesses a target or routes to a shell.
- Turning workspace automation Off, a failed handoff or an interrupted target
  stops further automatic advancement and leaves the recorded evidence visible.

## Human control and recovery

- Both modes stop at Completion Approval. Only the person can inspect the saved
  evidence and mark the run complete.
- Vendor permission and folder-trust prompts remain owned by the vendor CLI;
  Parley never bypasses them or infers completion from terminal text.
- Closing the main window keeps an active run alive while Parley remains open.
  Full application quit records an unfinished Auto run as interrupted and does
  not silently resume it on the next launch.
- In-app help, the README and the roadmap now describe the workflow and its
  safety boundary.

## Upgrade notes

- Workspace definitions, retained panes, credentials and existing
  collaboration records remain compatible with v0.1.9.
- Agent protocol v9 is unchanged, so panes already carrying v9 do not need a
  protocol restart for this release.

## Install and trust

- Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
- At least one supported, installed and signed-in vendor CLI.
- Download `Parley-0.1.10-mac-arm64.dmg`, quit Parley, replace `Parley.app` in
  Applications, and reopen it normally from Finder.
- This beta is ad-hoc signed and is **not notarized**. Use **System Settings >
  Privacy & Security > Open Anyway** only when the files came from this expected
  release. Never disable Gatekeeper globally.

Use `Parley-0.1.10-mac-arm64.SHA256SUMS` to verify every downloaded artifact.
